system.effect:
You may Shift as if you are Slowed. If you end this movement behind Blocking Terrain or in Obscuring Terrain, make a Stealth skill check with a DC of 14 plus 1 for every creature that can observe you. On a success you become Hidden. While Hidden, you have +2 Evasion against single-target attacks. Area of effect attacks do not suffer this penalty. Additionally, your next single target attack against a creature while Hidden has an increased +2 bonus to Accuracy checks, and an increased Critical and Effect Range of +1.

A creature can make a contested Perception Skill Check against your Stealth Skill Check to remove your Hidden condition. Your Hidden condition is also removed if you take a hostile action against a creature, or you are damaged by a direct attack.
